natural_language: Right stick Y-axis must be on axis 5, not axis 3
formal_expression: ∀ js_event e: (e.type == JS_EVENT_AXIS ∧ e.number == 5) → right_stick_y_value = e.value
code_implementation: if (event.number == 5) { axes[5] = event.value; /* Right stick Y */ }
rationale: ASTRO C40 controller maps right analog stick Y-axis to hardware axis 5, not the standard axis 3. This is a hardware-specific requirement discovered through empirical testing.
alternatives: Auto-detect which axis has Y movement
rejection_reasons: Would not work with ASTRO C40 hardware - empirically verified
Too complex and unreliable - user might move wrong stick during detection
Adds unnecessary complexity - we know it's axis 5
Would cause duplicate input and confusion

evidence.hardware_testing: Tested on actual ASTRO C40 controller
evidence.manufacturer_docs: ASTRO documentation confirms custom axis mapping
